```python
@login_required
def client_message_send(request, pk):
    if not request.user.can_approve_messages():
        messages.error(request, 'Access denied.')
        return redirect('dashboard')
    msg = get_object_or_404(ClientMessage, pk=pk)
    if msg.matter.is_read_only and not request.user.is_firm_admin():
        messages.error(request, 'This matter is read-only.')
        return redirect('matter_detail', pk=msg.matter.pk)
    if msg.status == 'approved' and not msg.sent_at:
        msg.status = 'sent'
        msg.sent_at = timezone.now()
        msg.save()
        log_action(request.user, 'update', 'ClientMessage', msg.pk, str(msg), 'Message sent to client', request)
        messages.success(request, 'Message sent.')
    return redirect('matter_detail', pk=msg.matter.pk)
```
